newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor to pay dividend after May 16.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor to pay dividend after May 16.

text.p: Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal will pay the dividend on its 1996 results after May 16, a company spokesman said.

Cimpor shares have risen in recent days on anticipation of the dividend payment and on good prospects for the building sector. At 1125 GMT the stock stood at 3,740 escudos, up 42, on volume of 492,659.
Cimpor has said it will to pay out a dividend of 125 escudos compared with the 115 it paid on its 1995 result.
The spokesman said the company would release its first quarter results at the end of May.
